line: 'My flush draws never hit.' From the flop, seeing both cards, they hit 1 in 3.

line: Chasing flushes isn't the leak; paying any price to chase them is.

line: Next time someone tells you a flush bad beat, ask: flop or turn? A flush draw comes in 1 in 3 from the flop, 1 in 5 from the turn.
